# CODE

## Syntax

```synesis
FIELD <name> TYPE CODE
    SCOPE <scope>
    [DESCRIPTION <text>]
    [GUIDELINES ... END GUIDELINES]
    [CONTEXT FROM DATASET <section>]
END FIELD
```

`[ ]` optional · `<>` value to replace

## Example

```synesis
FIELD example_code TYPE CODE
    SCOPE ITEM
END FIELD
```

## Value in the annotation

One or more concepts separated by commas:

```synesis
code: social cohesion, trust
```

Each concept should have an `ONTOLOGY` block. A missing comma between two concepts is caught by a dedicated detector.

## Properties

| Property | Status | Error if violated |
|---|---|---|
| `CONTEXT FROM DATASET` | Allowed | - |
| `DESCRIPTION` | Allowed | - |
| `GUIDELINES` | Allowed | - |
| `ARITY` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E055 |
| `FORMAT` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E054 |
| `RELATIONS` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E056 |
| `VALUES` | Forbidden | SYNESIS_E086 |

## Rules

- No required property. The field works with `SCOPE` alone.
